name: Ahrefs
description: Data, SEO and Scraping: SEO toolset with API v3 exposing Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, Rank Tracker, Site Audit and SERP data.
access_notes: API v3 requires a paid Ahrefs subscription (Lite/Standard/Advanced/Enterprise each include a monthly API-unit allowance; keys created self-serve in Account Settings > API Keys and sent as 'Authorization: Bearer'). Only Enterprise can buy extra units/overages. Building a public third-party integration via Ahrefs Connect uses OAuth 2.0 and requires an Enterprise plan to activate in production (free during development). Four free public endpoints exist without a subscription.
mcp_notes: Official hosted remote MCP at https://api.ahrefs.com/mcp/mcp (ahrefs.com/mcp; available on all paid plans; the older local @ahrefs/mcp repo is deprecated). Composio toolkit exists at composio.dev/toolkits/ahrefs with 40 tools.
uncertainty_notes: API is broad in endpoint surface but essentially read-only SEO data, hence breadth 'medium'. Webhook support not determined. Exact per-plan unit/row limits have changed over time; figures cited are from the official help article.

evidence.note: API v3 usable on Lite and higher paid plans with per-plan API-unit and max-rows limits; 'all new applications require a Lite or higher subscription'
Ahrefs Connect OAuth (client IDs/secrets, redirect URIs) for third-party integrations; Enterprise plan required to activate new integrations in production
Only 4 free public endpoints (crawler IPs, free domain rating) available without a subscription at api.ahrefs.com/v3/public
Official Ahrefs MCP, 'available on Lite, Standard, Advanced, and Enterprise' paid plans
Composio Ahrefs toolkit page listing 40 tools
